clips.title: The story
paras: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde is a night elf residing in the coastal port of Auberdine. Stationed along the misty Darkshore coast, she watches the tides and directs travelers to investigate the strange remains washing ashore. Her concerns center on the mysterious sea creatures and massive turtles whose carcasses have begun littering the northern beaches.

Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde makes her home in Auberdine, the bustling seaside haven of Darkshore. While many in town concern themselves with the forest or shipping across the Veiled Sea, Gwennyth keeps her gaze firmly on the coastline. The tides have recently turned grim, depositing the remains of colossal marine life onto the surf. To understand what is happening in the waters offshore, she relies on willing adventurers to scour the sands, retrieve skeletal samples, and bring back answers.
